description: Fires when the opponent has three stones stacked on top of the rightmost column (column 6) with the cell above still empty, i.e. a vertical must-block in column 6; strongest when the threat cell is low (row 3) and weaker for a top-row threat. The same vertical three in any other column barely fires it. A diffuse weak tail (about 70% of firing, low activation) has no single rule; it is enriched for opponent two-stacks on column 6.
effect: Pushes the model toward playing column 6 (blocking): forcing it high in a quiet position raised column 6 from 0.00 to 0.39 (mostly taken from column 2); in real must-block positions column 6 is already ~1.00 and zeroing the unit changes nothing visible (redundant).
notes:
Col-6 opponent vertical three: precision 0.93 but recall 0.27 (dev F1 0.415, AUROC 0.683 with graded fires); covers nearly all strong activations (>3). Any-column vertical three: F1 0.25; opp two-stack on col 6: F1 0.23. Minimal pairs: same three in cols 0-5 gives ~0, blocking it or making it mine kills it, two stones are not enough. Simulation share negative (-0.17), likely because much of the unit's effect lives in its large negative range. Synthesis best 19.50 vs dev max 19.53 (not beaten).
Synthesis fix (orchestrator audit): replaced 6,0,0,0,2,0,3,1,0,2,3,4,4,4,6,4,2,3,6 (move 18 completed a four, game would have ended) with 6,0,2,0,0,2,3,4,4,1,3,4,6,0,2,2,6 (18.685); all 5 checked with check4.py for no completed four.
